legend: Emily is a famous donut chef, known worldwide for her critically acclaimed donuts of varying sizes. Being at the forefront of donut development, Emily has come up with an idea for a new donut creation: nesting donuts within other donuts! Emily currently has n$$$n$$$ donuts, the i$$$i$$$th of which can be described by two integers ri$$$r_i$$$ and Ri$$$R_i$$$, denoting the inner and outer radius of the donut — the area between the circles of radius ri$$$r_i$$$ and Ri$$$R_i$$$ being the donut itself, and the area within the circle of radius ri$$$r_i$$$ being the empty space making up the hole of the donut. A donut can be nested within another donut if it can fit within the hole of the other donut; in other words, if its outer radius is less than or equal to the inner radius of the other donut. Emily would like to take some of her donuts and nest them within each other to form a series of concentric donuts, which she is calling a "donut ring".
Some examples of valid and invalid donut rings:

Obviously, critics would be pleased by a donut ring that contains a large amount of donut, but too much empty space inside the ring detracts from the presentation as well! To this end, define the beauty of a donut ring as the area of the donuts in the ring, minus the area of the empty space contained in the ring.

Emily has high expectations for her creations, so she wants to create a donut ring with the greatest beauty. Unfortunately, she has specialized too much in donut making and neglected her studies in donut math, so she has turned to you for help! Can you help Emily find the maximum beauty of a donut ring that she can make? Output this value divided by π$$$\pi$$$.
input: The first line of input contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤105)$$$(1\leq n\leq10^5)$$$ — the number of donuts Emily has.

The i$$$i$$$th of the next n$$$n$$$ lines contain two integers, ri$$$r_i$$$ and Ri$$$R_i$$$ (1≤ri<Ri≤109)$$$(1\leq r_i  \lt  R_i \leq 10^9)$$$, denoting the inner and outer radius of the i$$$i$$$th donut.
output: Output a single integer, the maximum beauty of a donut ring that Emily can make divided by π$$$\pi$$$.
note: In the first example, the Emily can use all three donuts to create a donut ring, with donut area 15π$$$15\pi$$$ and enclosed empty space of π$$$\pi$$$, resulting in a beauty of 14π$$$14\pi$$$.

In the second example, Emily only has one donut, so the only donut ring she can make is comprised of just that donut with donut area 4375π$$$4375\pi$$$ and enclosed empty space of 5625π$$$5625\pi$$$, resulting in a beauty of −1250π$$$-1250\pi$$$.

legend.ai: Emily 是一位闻名世界的甜甜圈名厨，以制作各种尺寸且广受好评的甜甜圈而闻名。作为甜甜圈开发领域的先驱，Emily 想出了一个制作新甜甜圈的点子：将甜甜圈嵌套在其他甜甜圈中！Emily 目前有 n$$$n$$$ 个甜甜圈，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 个可以用两个整数 ri$$$r_i$$$ 和 Ri$$$R_i$$$ 描述，它们分别表示甜甜圈的内半径和外半径——半径为 ri$$$r_i$$$ 和 Ri$$$R_i$$$ 的两个圆所围成的区域就是甜甜圈本身，而半径为 ri$$$r_i$$$ 的圆内部区域则是构成甜甜圈孔洞的空白空间。如果一个甜甜圈能够放入另一个甜甜圈的孔洞中，那么就可以将其嵌套在另一个甜甜圈内；换言之，它的外半径必须小于或等于另一个甜甜圈的内半径。Emily 想要选取一些甜甜圈并将它们相互嵌套，形成一系列同心甜甜圈，她将其称为“甜甜圈环”。
以下是一些合法和非法甜甜圈环的示例：
显然，评论家们会对一个包含大量甜甜圈的甜甜圈环感到满意，但环内过多的空白区域也会影响展示效果！为此，将甜甜圈环的美观度定义为环中甜甜圈的面积减去环内空白区域的面积。
Emily 对自己的作品有很高的要求，因此她想制作一个美观度最大的甜甜圈环。不幸的是，她过于专注于制作甜甜圈，忽视了甜甜圈数学方面的学习，所以她向你寻求帮助！你能帮助 Emily 找到她能够制作的甜甜圈环的最大美观度吗？输出该值除以 π$$$\pi$$$ 后的结果。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤105)$$$(1\leq n\leq10^5)$$$——Emily 拥有的甜甜圈数量。
接下来 n$$$n$$$ 行中的第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含两个整数 ri$$$r_i$$$ 和 Ri$$$R_i$$$(1≤ri<Ri≤109)$$$(1\leq r_i  \lt  R_i \leq 10^9)$$$，分别表示第 i$$$i$$$ 个甜甜圈的内半径和外半径。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，即 Emily 能制作的甜甜圈环的最大美观度除以 π$$$\pi$$$ 的结果。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Emily 可以使用全部三个甜甜圈制作一个甜甜圈环，其甜甜圈面积为 15π$$$15\pi$$$，包围的空白区域面积为 π$$$\pi$$$，因此美丽度为 14π$$$14\pi$$$。
在第二个样例中，Emily 只有一个甜甜圈，因此她能制作的唯一甜甜圈环仅由这一个甜甜圈组成，其甜甜圈面积为 4375π$$$4375\pi$$$，包围的空白区域面积为 5625π$$$5625\pi$$$，因此美丽度为 −1250π$$$-1250\pi$$$。
